notes: Covers machine types 20W0, 20W1, 20XK and 20XL. Some parts apply to selected models or AMD models only.

gaps: No part numbers, wattages, battery capacity or cell counts are recorded because the pages read do not state them.
Not recorded: memory module, M.2 SSDs, keyboard and trackpad (no matching part type).
The manual's Table 10 is headed for Intel models without RFID (PDF p.59), which is not carried into the spec.
method: Lenovo's T14 Gen 2 and P14s Gen 2 Hardware Maintenance Manual (eighth edition, August 2023; PDF p.2) names machine types 20W0, 20W1, 20XK and 20XL for the ThinkPad T14 Gen 2 on its About page (PDF p.5), and its FRU tables and removal steps are the source of the parts below.
The same manual also covers the P14s Gen 2.

comps.spec: Built-in battery, section 1090: removal step 2 takes four M2 x 4 mm flat-head nylon-coated screws at 0.18 +/- 0.015 Nm; on reinstall the battery connector and the base cover must be firmly attached or the battery connection may fail
Coin-cell battery: the checkout measures +2.5 to +3.2 V dc between the red wire and black ground, and says to replace the coin-cell battery if the voltage is not correct
LCD panel, LCD FRU 3; listed as neither a self-service nor an optional-service CRU
Speaker assembly, removal step 2 (section 1050): two M2 x 2.2 + 2.3 mm big-head nylon-coated screws at 0.18 +/- 0.015 Nm; the connector must be attached firmly on reinstall

Thermal fan assembly (section 1100): before refitting, apply 0.2 g of thermal grease to the two parts marked a and b; the manual shows separate illustrations for models with discrete thermal pipes and for models with an integrated thermal pipe, which it says is for T14 Gen 2 only

System board connector and cable guide (Table 10) lists internal and external connectors, including two Thunderbolt 4 USB-C connectors, HDMI, a 3.5-mm audio connector, a USB 3.2 connector Gen 1, the coin-cell and built-in battery connectors, and the memory module slot
ac power adapter (Table 7 item d), listed as a self-service CRU; the power cord (item c) is also listed as a self-service CRU
Conventional camera/mic combo board, LCD FRU 6 (for selected models); listed as neither a self-service nor an optional-service CRU
Microphone board, LCD FRU 5 (for selected models); listed as neither a self-service nor an optional-service CRU
Infrared camera/mic combo board, LCD FRU 7 (for selected models); listed as neither a self-service nor an optional-service CRU
Wireless LAN/WAN antenna assembly, LCD FRU 11 (for selected models); listed as neither a self-service nor an optional-service CRU
MIMO wireless-WAN antenna assembly, major FRU 9 (for selected models); listed as neither a self-service nor an optional-service CRU
Wireless LAN card, major FRU 19; the table marks it with footnote 2, which reads for AMD models only; listed as neither a self-service nor an optional-service CRU

Wireless WAN card, section 1060: removal step 3 takes one M2 x 2.5 mm big-head nylon-coated screw at 0.18 +/- 0.015 Nm; on reinstall, with two antenna cables orange goes to Orange and blue to Blue; with four cables the white and grey cable goes to M1 and the black and grey cable to M2
NFC module, major FRU 29 (for selected models); listed as neither a self-service nor an optional-service CRU
Always On USB 3.2 connector Gen 1 board, major FRU 10; listed as an optional-service CRU
